agentBearer.description: Agent API key returned during registration.

info.description: Cloud API for paxd registration, mailbox delivery, session snapshots, and user-managed platform API keys.
info.title: pax-manager Fleet Control Plane API

get.description: Returns pending mailbox messages for the whole agent. Prefer the session-scoped mailbox when the paxd connection is bound to a session.

parameters.description: Maximum number of messages to return.
parameters.name: limit

post.description: Stores the highest mailbox offset processed by the agent.
Marks a mailbox message completed or failed.
Registers a paxd agent with an owner-bound registration token.

parameters.description: One-time registration token minted by a user.
parameters.name: X-Registration-Token

get.description: Returns pending mailbox messages for a specific session owned by the authenticated agent.

parameters.description: Maximum number of messages to return.
parameters.name: limit

post.description: Upserts agent and session status using the paxd session shape.
Mints an owner-bound one-time agent registration token.

get.description: Lists agents visible to the current user.
Returns an agent visible to the current user.
Lists mailbox messages for an agent visible to the current user. This is an aggregate view; use the session-scoped route for a specific conversation.

parameters.description: Maximum number of messages to return.
parameters.name: limit

post.description: Queues a bootstrap or agent-level mailbox message. Once a session exists, prefer POST /api/user/agents/{agentId}/sessions/{sessionId}/messages.

get.description: Lists session snapshots for an agent visible to the current user.
Returns a session snapshot under an agent visible to the current user.
Lists mailbox messages for a specific session under an agent visible to the current user.

post.description: Queues a mailbox message for a specific session under an agent visible to the current user.

get.description: Lists API keys owned by the current user.

post.description: Creates a user platform API key. The plain key is returned once.

delete.description: Revokes a user platform API key.

tags.description: paxd-facing endpoints authenticated with bearer agent API keys.
tags.name: agent
